name: a plain string passes through
why: A theme that is not translated should not have to write a per-language object.

name: exact match
why: The most specific entry always wins.

name: a region falls back to its base language
why: es-419 (Latin America) is almost never declared; it must land on es.

name: a base language finds a regional variant
why: If the theme only ships pt-BR and Obsidian is set to pt, that beats English.

name: among several variants the first alphabetically wins
why: It has to be DETERMINISTIC: Go maps iterate randomly and both implementations must agree.

name: an unknown language falls back to English
why: English is the format's declared fallback.

name: with no English it falls back to the first alphabetically
why: Showing something beats showing nothing. And it must be stable.

name: an empty locale is treated as English
why: That is Obsidian's default when the user never picked a language.

name: an exact region beats the base language
why: If the theme bothered to distinguish pt-BR, honour it.

name: an empty object returns empty
why: There is nothing to show and it must not throw.
